risk.title: Risk index
risk.subtitle: Prioritises which enumerators and teams to back-check (verification re-interview).
risk.loadError: Could not load the risk index.
risk.warningTitle: A signal to prioritise, not proof
risk.warningBody: The index combines statistical signals relative to peers to PRIORITISE who to re-interview. It does not prove fabrication and needs enough volume of submissions per person and per team to be meaningful.
risk.disabled: The risk index is not enabled for this form. Turn it on by setting a minimum number of submissions per enumerator/team.
risk.noData: No enumerators with enough submissions to score yet.
risk.noComponents: No computable signals for this enumerator.

explain.percentmatch: Their submissions look very much alike. May indicate copied answers, or a short questionnaire where matching is normal.
explain.straightlining: Tends to pick the same option across many questions. May be fast filling, or questions that genuinely share an answer.
explain.distribution: Their answers are distributed differently from the rest. May indicate bias or fabrication, or a genuinely different population.
explain.skip_rate: Leaves blanks or answers «don't know» at a different rate than peers. Very high can be laziness; very low, filling everything without asking.
explain.benford: The leading digit of their numbers departs from what's expected in natural data. May indicate made-up figures, or magnitudes that don't follow the pattern.
explain.productivity: Completes many more interviews per day than peers. May indicate fabricated records, or simply longer working hours.
explain.gps_cluster: Their GPS points are very close together. May indicate surveys filled from one spot, or a small work area.
explain.qc_flag_rate: Quality control flags more of their submissions than their peers' (short ones, real consecutive overlaps and duplicates; the flags that are noisy under power cuts don't count). May indicate fabrication, or a stretch of hard conditions.
explain.team_distribution: The team's answer distribution departs from that of the other teams. May indicate a team problem, or a different area.

reason.no_repeated_content: Not enough submissions with answers to compare.
reason.no_select_one: The form has no single-choice questions.
reason.no_numeric: The form has no numeric questions.
